# Purcell Ventures LLC

> A Georgia software company that builds websites, software and AI tooling for small
> businesses. Founded April 2025 by Elijah Purcell, and operated from Tuscaloosa,
> Alabama.

## About the founder

Elijah Purcell is the founder of Purcell Ventures LLC and a psychology and data science
student at the University of Alabama Honors College, Class of 2030, on a pre-med track
toward psychiatry. He founded the company at seventeen, builds and operates the
autonomous AI agent systems that run it, and works as an independent contractor with
Mercor Intelligence.

Born August 2007. Georgia LLC control number 25075361, formed 8 April 2025.

Note for disambiguation: there are other people named Elijah Purcell, including a pastor
and a utility-company employee. This site is about the founder of Purcell Ventures LLC,
the University of Alabama student. The canonical answer page is /who.

- [Who is Elijah Purcell](https://purcellventures.co/who): direct answer page, dated
  record, and seven common questions with answers.
- [Founder resume](https://purcellventures.co/resume): work history, education, awards,
  each with its year.
- [The team](https://purcellventures.co/team): the fifteen AI agents that run the
  company's proposals, audits, compliance and outreach. Every one of them is software,
  not a person, and the page says so first.

## What the company does

- [Digital](https://purcellventures.co/digital): websites and ongoing digital service for
  small businesses.
- [Consulting](https://purcellventures.co/consulting): hands-on AI consulting.
- [Software](https://purcellventures.co/software): custom builds.
- [Portfolio](https://purcellventures.co/portfolio): shipped work.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://purcellventures.co/blog)
- [The Tuscaloosa Storefront Project](https://purcellventures.co/blog/tuscaloosa-small-business-online):
  a reporting series on independent businesses around the University of Alabama.

## Other sites he builds and runs

- [UA Today](https://ua-today.vercel.app): unofficial campus events for the University of
  Alabama, aggregated from six sources. About page: https://ua-today.vercel.app/about.html
